newsitem.title: USA: Dakota says shrholder vote set for May 22.
newsitem.headline: Dakota says shrholder vote set for May 22.

text.p: Dakota Mining Corporation said Monday that subject to timely approvals, the annual general meeting and special meeting at which shareholders will vote on the merger with USMX Inc is set for May 22.
The company said the record date for the meeting will be April 14.
Dakota also said it was working with USMX to ensure the completion of construction of the Illinois Creek Mine in Alaska in preparation for gold production to commence in June.

"We are planning on producing 65,000-70,000 equivalent ounces of gold at Illinois Creek this year," said Alan Bell, President of Dakota, in a statement, "and production from all mines in 1997 should exceed 140,000 ounces of gold."
